import sys

def main():
    lines = [line.strip() for line in sys.stdin if line.strip()]
    n = int(lines[0])
    arr = list(map(int, lines[1].split()))
    k = int(lines[2])
    if n == 0:
        print("")
        return
    k %= n
    rotated = arr[k:] + arr[:k]
    print(' '.join(map(str, rotated)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
